patterns.note: A flexible grid system is used to showcase projects, primarily in a three-column layout, but adapting to two columns or a single full-width image for varied emphasis.
The main header, including the studio name and navigation links, remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
New project sections and images are revealed with a subtle upward slide or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The site employs a minimalist color palette of a light beige background and black text, allowing the vibrant, high-quality project imagery to be the sole source of color and visual interest.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established with a very large, bold, uppercase sans-serif for the studio name, contrasting with smaller, regular weight sans-serif for navigation and extremely small project details.

technique_notes: The header navigation is implemented as a sticky element that maintains its position at the top of the viewport, overlaying content as the user scrolls.
Content sections, primarily image grids, are revealed with a subtle upward slide or fade-in effect as they enter the user's viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience.
The site uses a flexible grid system to display project images, adapting from three-column layouts to two-column or single-column full-width presentations to highlight specific projects.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif for the main studio name (~4-5x body text), with smaller, regular weight uppercase navigation and very small, regular weight project descriptions.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced; the header has generous spacing, and grid items maintain consistent padding around images.

standout: This site stands out for its extreme minimalism, acting as a clean, almost invisible canvas that puts 100% of the focus on large, high-quality project photography. The design is essentially a sophisticated gallery, where text is secondary and only provides essential context.
